plain_language.what_this_is: A plain-language description of what is now frozen and what the next founder decision would be. It authorizes nothing by itself.
plain_language.what_changed_in_this_wave: The package was re-bound to the exact authority implementation that passed the sixth independent Checker and the sequential Advisor, and the provider binary was re-verified and re-frozen against that exact authority candidate.
what_is_still_required_before_anything_r: an INDEPENDENT package Checker must review this package and return a clean verdict — the Builder cannot issue it

a FINAL-HEAD CAPSULE must be regenerated, outside the repository, bound to the exact final commit of this branch (tools/terminal0/lrcq/final-head-capsule.mjs). The committed package material deliberately does NOT bind the final commit, because a commit cannot contain its own identifier. Until that capsule exists and verifies, the production preflight refuses with a BINDING-DEFECT and nothing can be signed
the founder must enroll exactly one public founder key (no key is enrolled: active_keys is empty)
the founder must sign the activation payload with that key
nothing runs until all of those steps happen
plain_language.about_the_two_capsule_stages: There are two artifacts, not one. The COMMITTED package material proves what the package binds and that its bytes are intact. A separate FINAL-HEAD CAPSULE, generated outside the repository after the last commit is made, is what a signature is actually applied to. Any new commit on this branch invalidates a previously generated capsule on purpose, and it must be regenerated. See PACKAGE_CANDIDATE_SCOPE.json and PROCEDURAL_FINAL_HEAD_CAPSULE_CONTRACT.json.
plain_language.about_the_retired_gate_packet: UNSIGNED_GATE_PACKET.json is a retired earlier draft, kept only as history. It is marked STALE-INTERMEDIATE-CANDIDATE, still contains blanks for you to fill that were never filled, and is refused outright by the production entrypoints. The current material is UNSIGNED_ACTIVATION_MATERIAL_PACKET.json.
honest_limits: Real productive Claude behaviour is NOT proven here and is first observed under signature.
